R1.name: Free Forever
R1.supporting_message: No Trial Clock. No Subscription. No Surprise.

R2.name: Free Forever + One-Time Purchase
R2.primary_tagline: Start Free. Pay Once. Keep Using It.
R2.supporting_message: No Monthly Meter Running. No Hidden Costs.

R3.name: Free Forever + Subscription
R3.primary_tagline: Start Free. Upgrade When You're Ready.

R4.name: Time-Limited Trial + One-Time Purchase
R4.primary_tagline: Try It. Test It. Buy It Only If It Works for You.

claims.label: Free forever
claims.definition: Stated free functionality remains usable indefinitely without mandatory payment for that functionality.
claims.applicability: Product primary_release_model is R1, R2, or R3 and marketing uses free-forever language.
evidence_required: store listing or hub copy alignment
claims.automated_check: verify-nivo78-family-philosophy-registry.ps1 claim schema; product gate adapters when assigned
claims.manual_evidence: Release notes and tier documentation showing free tier boundaries.
claims.failure_condition: Trial clock, paywall, or subscription required for functionality described as free forever.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Do not use free-forever claims unless primary_release_model and shipped behavior match.

claims.label: One-time purchase
claims.definition: Customer may buy a defined capability once without mandatory recurring billing for that purchase.
claims.applicability: R2 or R4 products or explicit one-time SKU.
claims.automated_check: manual until product billing manifest is machine-readable
claims.manual_evidence: Store console and in-app upgrade copy review.
claims.failure_condition: Purchase silently converts to subscription or hides recurring charges.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: No one-time purchase claim without license terms disclosure.

claims.label: No subscription
claims.definition: Product or tier does not require recurring payment for the described capability.
claims.applicability: R1 and one-time tiers; never for R3 paid tiers.
claims.automated_check: claim id must not appear in MARKETING_COPY when primary_release_model is R3
claims.failure_condition: Marketing says no subscription while product requires subscription for core work.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Claim only when primary_release_model and tier docs support it.

claims.label: No account required
claims.definition: Ordinary core use does not require creating a Nivo78 or product-vendor account.
claims.applicability: All products unless documented unavoidable exception.
evidence_required: no mandatory login gate for core workflows
claims.automated_check: APP-DATA-NO-TELEMETRY and legal guardrails where present
claims.failure_condition: Core workflow blocked without account when claim is published.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Document exceptions explicitly in Help and privacy.

claims.label: No ads
claims.definition: No in-app advertising, banners, or sponsored content in customer workflows.
claims.applicability: All Nivo78 customer applications.
claims.failure_condition: Advertising SDK or ad UI in production paths.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Never claim no ads if any ad network is linked.

claims.label: No nags
claims.definition: No intrusive upgrade nags, notification spam, or manipulative dark patterns.
claims.applicability: All products.
claims.failure_condition: Repeated unsolicited upgrade or review prompts.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Do not claim no nags if timed popups push upgrades.

claims.label: No tracking
claims.definition: No behavioral tracking, advertising surveillance, or undisclosed analytics profiles.
claims.applicability: All products.
claims.manual_evidence: Network traffic review for release builds.
claims.failure_condition: Undisclosed third-party analytics or ad ID use.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Security diagnostics require separate disclosure and consent.

claims.label: Local-first
claims.definition: Core workflows operate on device-local data without requiring continuous cloud access.
claims.applicability: Products advertising local-first or offline core work.
claims.failure_condition: Essential advertised workflow fails offline.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Do not claim local-first if cloud is mandatory for core jobs.

claims.label: Offline operation
claims.definition: Advertised functionality works without network for the stated scope.
claims.applicability: When marketing or Help claims offline use.
claims.failure_condition: Claimed offline feature requires network.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Scope offline claims to tested workflows.

claims.label: Optional cloud
claims.definition: Cloud features are additive; core workflows do not require Nivo78 cloud.
claims.applicability: Products with any cloud or sync feature.
evidence_required: no hard cloud gate on core save path
claims.failure_condition: Unrelated core workflow blocked without cloud login.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Label cloud-dependent features explicitly.

claims.label: Portable import/export
claims.definition: Industry-appropriate import/export paths exist with documented limitations.
claims.applicability: Products with interop_applicable true or data exchange surface.
claims.failure_condition: Marketing claims portability without matrix or tests.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: No complete portability claim when lossy conversion exists.

claims.label: No lock-in
claims.definition: No artificial vendor lock-in; practical export and migration paths documented.
claims.applicability: All products storing customer data.
claims.failure_condition: Subscription cancellation or license expiry blocks data export unreasonably.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Do not claim no lock-in if export requires undocumented proprietary-only path.

claims.label: Security
claims.definition: Security controls implemented per FAMILY-SECURITY-BASELINE; no false certification claims.
claims.applicability: All products.
claims.failure_condition: Claimed certification or guarantee without evidence.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Never claim verified security property without audit evidence.

claims.label: Responsive feedback
claims.definition: Discoverable feedback path and family acknowledgement target (not a public SLA).
claims.applicability: All shippable products.
claims.failure_condition: No intake path or marketing promises impossible response times.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Do not advertise response SLAs unless measured and approved.

claims.label: Affordable pricing
claims.definition: Pricing presented clearly; affordability is objective, not competitive superlatives.
claims.applicability: Public pricing copy.
claims.automated_check: grep guardrail for prohibited superlatives in MARKETING_COPY
claims.failure_condition: Hidden fees or unsubstantiated lowest-cost claims.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Prohibited: lowest cost in the industry without substantiation.

claims.label: Lifetime updates
claims.definition: Updates included for the period defined in license terms only.
claims.applicability: When license or marketing mentions lifetime updates.
claims.failure_condition: Marketing promises lifetime updates license does not grant.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Match lifetime language to actual license duration.

claims.label: Complete export
claims.definition: Export includes all customer-created data within documented exclusions.
claims.applicability: When export completeness is claimed.
claims.failure_condition: Claimed complete export omits documented categories silently.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: State explicit export exclusions.

claims.label: Full-function trial
claims.definition: During a disclosed time-limited trial, advertised paid features are available without artificial caps imposed solely to force conversion; limits are disclosed before activation.
claims.applicability: Product offers a time-limited trial and marketing uses full-function, full-featured, or equivalent trial language.
evidence_required: trial disclosure in hub, Help, and in-app status
claims.manual_evidence: Trial UX walkthrough and entitlement matrix review.
claims.failure_condition: Trial withholds material advertised paid capability, uses undisclosed artificial usage caps, or silently charges on expiry.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Do not advertise a full-function trial when material paid functionality is unavailable during the trial.

claims.label: Primary trial tagline
claims.definition: Try Everything. Decide for Yourself. — trial provides meaningful access to the paid functionality being evaluated.
claims.applicability: Product offers a time-limited trial and uses the family primary trial tagline or equivalent Try Everything wording.
evidence_required: trial disclosure adjacent to tagline in MARKETING_COPY or hub
claims.automated_check: TrialTaglineVerifier unit tests; APP-TRIAL-TAGLINE-TRUTH gate adapter
claims.failure_condition: Primary tagline used while material paid capability is withheld or trial context is omitted.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Do not use the primary tagline without trial/evaluation disclosure and behavior that supports meaningful paid-feature access.

claims.label: No obligation to buy (trial)
claims.definition: Trial participation alone does not obligate purchase; payment method, auto-conversion, renewal, and cancellation are accurately disclosed before activation.
claims.applicability: Supporting statement or copy includes no obligation to buy or equivalent.
claims.manual_evidence: Store listing and in-app trial activation flow review.
claims.failure_condition: No-obligation language paired with undisclosed auto-billing or silent subscription conversion.
claims.unsupported_marketing_rule: Disclose payment, renewal, and cancellation before trial activation when using no-obligation language.
